title: Microbial Sampling of Carious Dentin
brief_summary: The School of Dentistry is seeking to determine whether viable microorganisms remain within tooth structure after conventional, mechanical removal of areas of tooth decay, prior to placement or replacement of tooth restorations (fillings). The long-term goal of the work is to decrease the failure rate, and therefore increase the longevity, of tooth restorations (fillings) in human patients and populations.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged 18-99, Male or Female, No significant systemic illness

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diabetic, Hypertensive, Pregnant
study_population: The School of Dentistry will seek dental patient volunteers to participate in the study if patient meets all inclusion and exclusion criteria and is in need of a Class II filling placement. Flyers will be placed in the reception area of the School of Dentistry clinic. Student dentists will also inform study staff if he/she has a patient who meets the inclusion and exclusion criteria of the study. Study staff will approach the patient to seek informed consent.
